description: A React component implementing a to-do list application with CRUD operations, styled with CSS modules, fetching data from an API endpoint.

methods.name: getToDos
methods.description: Fetches the list of to-dos from the API and updates state.

methods.name: createToDo
methods.description: Creates a new to-do item by posting to the API and refreshes the list.

methods.name: updateToDo
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a to-do and updates it via API.

methods.name: deleteToDo
methods.description: Deletes a to-do item via API and refreshes the list after a delay.

calls: fetch('api/todos', { method: 'post', body: JSON.stringify({ content: newContent }) })
